metadata.statuteRef: Cal. Civ. Code § 1793.22 (Tanner Consumer Protection Act) & § 1790 et seq. (Song-Beverly)

lemonLaw.coveragePeriod: 18 months / 18,000 miles (Vehicles) | Express Warranty Window (Consumer Goods)
specialRules: Song-Beverly Act extends non-waivable implied warranty protections to ALL consumer goods in California.
Prevailing consumers recover 100% of reasonable attorney fees and costs under Cal. Civ. Code § 1794(d).
Civil penalty up to 2x actual damages for willful failure to repair or repurchase.
